title: Yoeleo Altera G21 gravel frameset recheck
notes: Exact G21 frameset page describes a gravel and adventure riding experience, lists four bottle mounts, Mudguard Compatible: Yes and Cargo Rack Compatible: Yes, top-tube and down-tube storage, and a 700x53 mm or 650B x 2.1 in maximum with a single chainring. No 2x maximum is published.
